---
title: "OMK JSON: the omk vocabulary"
subtitle: "Draft 0.1 — not yet stable"
---

| | |
|---|---|
| URI | `https://openmusickit.org/spec/omk` |
| version | `0.1` |
| prefix | `omk`; its names are written bare |

The core vocabulary: every node type, every edge kind and relation,
the values that belong to no particular musical system,
and the kinds that other vocabularies add their own types to.
Every document uses it.
The format itself (primitive types, the envelope, the canonical form)
is in [the format specification](omk-json.qmd);
section numbers below (§4.3) refer to it.

In the tables, a type with a trailing `?` admits `null`.
A **kind** in a field's type (written in *italics*, as *Duration*)
means a tagged value of any type belonging to that kind (§7.3),
from this vocabulary or any other.

## Kinds

| kind | what it is | `omk` types | `wsmn` types |
|---|---|---|---|
| *Duration* | a signed length of time, or none | `ZeroDuration`, `GraceDuration`, `ClockDuration` | `MetricalDuration`, `TiedDuration` |
| *Measurable* | a length that reduces to one number: every *Duration* above, and groupings of them | the *Duration* types, `TemporalUnit`, `CompoundTemporalUnit` | the *Duration* types, `TimeSignature` |
| *TemporalRatio* | one length against another: a tuplet, a tempo, a metric modulation | `TemporalRatio`, `Tempo` | |
| *Tone* | something sounded, or silence | `SilentTone` | `TonalVector`, `PercussionTone` |
| *Interval* | the distance between two tones | | `TonalVector` |
| *ToneCollection* | an ordered collection of tones | `ToneCollection` | `Chord`, `ChordType` |
| *ModalContext* | a key, mode, raga, maqam, ... | | `Key` |
| *Clef* | how a staff maps to pitch | | `StaffClef` |
| *DivisionShape* | how a division (a bar line) is drawn | | `BarLineShape` |
| *StackGroupShape* | how a group of stacked things is drawn | | `BracketShape` |

## Systems

| identifier | system | type |
|---|---|---|
| `any` | belongs to no temporal system in particular; compatible with all | temporal |
| `clock-time` | real time, measured in microseconds | temporal |
| `any` | belongs to no tonal system in particular; compatible with all | tonal |

## Nodes

A node of any type may be the source or target of any edge
unless a rule in §10 of the format specification says otherwise.

### Events

*Sequential events* take up time and are placed in lines by `Next` edges.
An event's `duration`, where it has one, MUST NOT be negative.

**`NoteEvent`**: something sounded (or a rest) for a duration.

| field | type | domain |
|---|---|---|
| `duration` | *Duration*? | not negative; `null` is a duration not yet known |
| `tones` | `set<`*Tone*`>` | if it holds a `SilentTone`, it holds nothing else (a rest) |

**`ChordEvent`**: a chord symbol (a harmony, as in a lead sheet), not a chord of notes.

| field | type | domain |
|---|---|---|
| `duration` | *Duration*? | not negative |
| `chord` | *ToneCollection* | |

**`LyricSyllable`**: one syllable of a word, sung over a duration.

| field | type | domain |
|---|---|---|
| `duration` | *Duration*? | not negative |
| `word` | `Word` | |
| `index` | `integer` | 0 ≤ `index` < the number of syllables in `word` |

Each syllable carries its whole word.
Syllables of one word carry equal `Word` values.

**`DivisionEvent`**: a division between one stretch of a line and the next
(in WSMN, a bar line). It has zero duration, and no `duration` field.

| field | type | domain |
|---|---|---|
| `shape` | *DivisionShape*? | `null` is a division whose drawing is unspecified |

### Context events

A context event changes how later material in its line is read.
It has zero duration, and no `duration` field.

**`ModalContextEvent`**

| field | type |
|---|---|
| `modal_context` | *ModalContext*? |

**`MeterEvent`**

| field | type |
|---|---|
| `meter` | *Measurable*? |

**`TempoEvent`**

| field | type |
|---|---|
| `tempo` | *TemporalRatio*? |
| `term` | `TempoTerm`? |

**`ClefEvent`**

| field | type |
|---|---|
| `clef` | *Clef*? |

### Marks

**`Marking`**: a mark attached to one node (by a `marks` edge from the marking).

| field | type | domain |
|---|---|---|
| `mark` | `Mark` | its `attachment_mode` is not `"span"` |

**`MarkSpanner`**: a mark over a run of a line,
from the target of its `starts_at` edge to the target of its `ends_at` edge.

| field | type | domain |
|---|---|---|
| `mark` | `Mark` | its `attachment_mode` is not `"single"` |

### Lyrics

**`LyricSection`**: a span over a run of lyrics: a verse, a chorus.

| field | type | domain |
|---|---|---|
| `section_type` | `string?` | |
| `section_number` | `integer?` | |
| `section_name` | `string?` | |
| `language` | `string?` | a [BCP 47](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/bcp47) language tag |

### Performers, groups and scores

**`Part`**: an instrument, and by extension whoever plays it.

| field | type |
|---|---|
| `name` | `string` |

**`PercussionPart`**: a part played on percussion.

| field | type |
|---|---|
| `name` | `string` |
| `palette` | *ToneCollection*? |

**`Stint`**: a part's run on a line, from the target of its `starts_at` edge
to the target of its `ends_at` edge.

| field | type | |
|---|---|---|
| `transposition` | *Interval*? | the interval the reader applies to the notes, if any |

**`LineGroup`**: lines that are done together and timed from one origin
(the hands of a pianist, the drums of a kit).

| field | type |
|---|---|
| `name` | `string?` |

**`StackGroup`**: a span over a run of a stack (a bracket over the strings).

| field | type |
|---|---|
| `name` | `string?` |
| `abbreviation` | `string?` |
| `shape` | *StackGroupShape*? |

**`Score`**: a work's metadata; names one connected part of the graph.

| field | type |
|---|---|
| `title` | `string?` |
| `subtitle` | `string?` |
| `composer` | `string?` |
| `lyricist` | `string?` |
| `arranger` | `string?` |
| `copyright` | `string?` |
| `opus` | `string?` |
| `dedication` | `string?` |

### Timelines

**`SyncLine`**: a named timeline in its own temporal system (a stopwatch, a film reel).

| field | type |
|---|---|
| `temporal_system` | temporal system identifier |
| `name` | `string?` |
| `description` | `string?` |

**`SyncPoint`**: an instant on a sync line.

| field | type | domain |
|---|---|---|
| `offset` | *Duration* | signed: from the sync line's origin |
| `name` | `string?` | |
| `description` | `string?` | |

## Edges

### Edge relations

An edge's relation is one of these, or a relation defined by another vocabulary:

`"next"`, `"branches"`, `"simultaneous"`, `"performs"`, `"implements"`, `"realizes"`,
`"annotates"`, `"marks"`, `"lyric"`, `"accompanies"`, `"harmonizes"`, `"variation_of"`,
`"derivative_of"`, `"contains"`, `"references"`, `"user_defined"`, `"starts_at"`,
`"ends_at"`, `"stacks_above"`.

### Edge enumerations

| enumeration | values |
|---|---|
| origin | `"asserted"`, `"derived"`, `"inferred"` |
| anchor | `"onset"`, `"offset"` |

### Edge kinds

**`Next`**: the target follows the source in a line. Relation `next`.

| field | type |
|---|---|
| `origin` | origin |

**`Branch`**: the target is the head of a second line of the same performer
(a second voice), starting at the source's `anchor` plus the `displacement`.
Relation `branches`.

| field | type | domain |
|---|---|---|
| `origin` | origin | |
| `anchor` | anchor | |
| `displacement` | *Duration*? | signed; `null` means none |

**`Simultaneous`**: the target, an event of another line, happens when the source does
(at its `anchor`, plus the `displacement`). Relation `simultaneous`.

| field | type | domain |
|---|---|---|
| `origin` | origin | |
| `anchor` | anchor | |
| `displacement` | *Duration*? | signed; `null` means none |

**`Contains`**: from a `LineGroup` to the head of one of its lines,
which starts at the group's origin plus the `displacement`. Relation `contains`.

| field | type | domain |
|---|---|---|
| `origin` | origin | |
| `displacement` | *Duration*? | signed; `null` means none |

**`Edge`**: any other relationship, carrying no timing.
A `Score`'s `contains` edges are of this kind:
a score is not a timing origin, so it says nothing about when anything happens.
So are a `SyncLine`'s `contains` edges to its `SyncPoint`s,
since each point carries its own `offset`.

| field | type |
|---|---|
| `origin` | origin |
| `relation` | relation |

## Values

**`SilentTone`**: silence; the tone of a rest. No fields. Kind *Tone*.

**`ZeroDuration`**: no length at all, in any system. No fields. Kinds *Duration*, *Measurable*.

**`GraceDuration`**: the zero length of a grace note,
with the note value it is drawn as. Kinds *Duration*, *Measurable*.

| field | type | |
|---|---|---|
| `nominal` | *Duration* | the value it is drawn as |
| `on_beat` | `boolean` | `true` takes its time from the note it precedes |

**`ClockDuration`**: a signed length of real time. Kinds *Duration*, *Measurable*.

| field | type | |
|---|---|---|
| `microseconds` | `rational` | signed |

**`TemporalUnit`**: a count of some length (three eighths). Kind *Measurable*.

| field | type | domain |
|---|---|---|
| `count` | `integer` | not negative |
| `base` | *Measurable* | |

**`CompoundTemporalUnit`**: a sequence of lengths taken together (2 + 2 + 3 eighths).
Kind *Measurable*.

| field | type |
|---|---|
| `units` | `array<`*Measurable*`>` |

**`TemporalRatio`**: one length against another
(3 quarters in the time of 2; a quarter in the time of an eighth). Kind *TemporalRatio*.

| field | type |
|---|---|
| `nominal` | *Measurable* |
| `contextual` | *Measurable* |

**`Tempo`**: a number of beats in a span of clock time (♩ = 120). Kind *TemporalRatio*.

| field | type | |
|---|---|---|
| `count` | `integer` | the number of beats |
| `beat` | *Duration* | the beat |
| `clock_time` | `ClockDuration` | the span; one minute is `60000000` microseconds |

**`ToneCollection`**: an ordered collection of tones, with an optional root and name.
Order is significant (it tells an added 2nd from an added 9th). Kind *ToneCollection*.

| field | type | |
|---|---|---|
| `tones` | `array<`*Tone*`>` | |
| `root` | *Tone*? | |
| `name` | `string?` | a name template (below) |

**`Mark`**: a mark in a notation system's vocabulary (a staccato dot, a slur, *mf*).
Marks are written in full, never by name,
so a document does not depend on any table of marks.

| field | type | domain |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | |
| `description` | `string?` | |
| `kind` | mark kind? | |
| `attachment_mode` | attachment mode? | |
| `aliases` | `array<string>` | |
| `binds` | `boolean` | `true` if the events under the mark are one articulation (a slur, a tie) |

**`TempoTerm`**: a tempo word (*Allegro*, *a tempo*).

| field | type |
|---|---|
| `name` | `string` |
| `description` | `string?` |
| `aliases` | `array<string>` |

**`Word`**: a word of lyrics, divided into syllables.

| field | type | domain |
|---|---|---|
| `syllables` | `array<string>` | at least one; no syllable empty or only whitespace |
| `stress` | `array<`lexical stress?`>` | as many as `syllables`; at most one `"primary"` |

### Value enumerations

| enumeration | values |
|---|---|
| mark kind | `"articulation"`, `"dynamic"`, `"ornament"`, `"technique"`, `"fingering"`, `"bowing"`, `"breath"`, `"ficta"`, `"phrasing"`, `"navigation"`, `"transposition"`, `"expression"`, `"rehearsal"`, `"other"` |
| attachment mode | `"single"`, `"span"`, `"either"` |
| lexical stress | `"unstressed"`, `"secondary"`, `"primary"` |

### Name templates

A `ToneCollection`'s `name` (and the `name` of the `wsmn` chord types)
is a template, so that a chord's name follows its root through transposition.
It is literal text, in which:

- `{root}` stands for the root, in its default display form;
- `{root:FORM}` stands for the root in the display form `FORM`,
  one of the forms the root's own vocabulary defines
  (for `wsmn:TonalVector`, see the [`wsmn` vocabulary](vocabulary-wsmn.qmd#pitch));
- `{{` and `}}` stand for a literal `{` and `}`.

No other use of braces is allowed:
a template holding any other `{` or `}` is outside the field's domain.
A template that uses `{root}` in a collection whose `root` is `null` is also outside it.
